name: Puncture Critical Strike Table
rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax are inclusive on an UNMODIFIED d100. The first band (rollMin=null) is the low catch-all; rolls above 100 (modified criticals) clamp to the top band.

A.text: Foe avoids most of the attack.

C.text: Foe dances clear of the worst.
Nick your weapon and your foe.

E.text: Shot unbalances foe. You have initiative.

A.text: Strike causes foe to flinch. You gain initiative next round.

B.text: Foe questions his resolve. You gain initiative next round.

C.text: Foe's evasion puts him out of position. You gain initiative next round.

D.text: Foe evades and maneuvers for a better position.

E.text: Foe is fearful of your skill and steps back from your mighty onslaught.

B.text: Foe steps back and avoids the worst.

C.text: Blow to foe's side. If foe has a belt it is severed.

D.text: Precise strike to foe's side. You have the initiative for 1 round.

E.text: Foe vibrates from the impact of the strike.

A.text: Convince foe of his peril by just missing his abdomen.

B.text: Foe is uncertain about your next attack. He chooses to let you make the first move (you gain the initiative).

C.text: Strike crosses foe's head. If he has a helm it is knocked off and dented.

D.text: You wound foe in hip. Strike strips equipment from right side of waist.

E.text: Deal foe a measurable blow to his side. Any one container on your foe now has a hole in it.

A.text: Nick foe's calf with long follow through.

C.text: Strike along foe's calf. The damage takes a moment to show.

E.text: Strike to upper leg rips clothing.

A.text: Foe's evasion exposes his back to your strike.

B.text: Blow to back damages any equipment worn there.

C.text: Lower back strike sends foe reeling. His guard is still up.

D.text: Light strike pins foe's weapon arm to his side.

E.text: Strike to side. If foe has armor, the blow tears it open and exposes skin.

A.text: Strike to foe's chest and he looks impressed.

B.text: Solid strike to foe's chest. Blood from wound ruins any heraldry.

C.text: Strike toward chest. If foe has a shield, it is out of position for the rest of the round.

D.text: Solid chest strike leaves bruises and blood.

E.text: Foe goes low to evade your attack. Strike takes foe down on one knee. Finish him.

A.text: Minor thigh wound. It could have been better.

E.text: Blow to foe's side. He stumbles to your right 10 feet.

A.text: Minor forearm wound numbs foe's grip.

B.text: Forearm strike shakes foe up. Foe attempts a recovery.

C.text: Solid strike to foe's right forearm.

D.text: Blow to foe's weapon arm. Arm is numb.

E.text: Catch foe's forearm. The wound opens up nicely. Foe is in pain.

A.text: Strike to foe's shield shoulder. Arm is useless. That must really hurt!

B.text: Foe blocks your attack with his elbow. Elbow is shattered. Shield arm is useless.

C.text: Strike shatters foe's knee. Foe crumbles to the ground. He is down for 3 rounds.

D.text: Strike to head kills foe, if he has no helm. If he has a helm he is knocked out for 6 hours.

E.text: Strike through both of foe's lungs. Foe drops and passes out. He dies 6 rounds later.

B.text: Strike to foe's neck. It's not enough for a kill.

C.text: Strike along foe's neck. Foe is frantic to evade death.

D.text: Strike down foe's defenses with a blow to both arms.

E.text: Shot raises foe's arm up, severing many muscles and tendons. Arm is useless.

B.text: Strike to foe's calf. Slash muscle. Foe almost falls down.

C.text: Destructive strike to lower leg. If foe has leg armor, it is torn free.

D.text: Excellent blow to lower leg slashes muscles and cartilage. Foe falls prone.

E.text: Strike plunges into leg with deadly effect. Foe drops, gripping his leg in pain.

A.text: Strike foe in upper arm. You tear his pretty clothes.

B.text: Strike to shield side. If foe has shield, your weapon is stuck in it for a round.

C.text: Strike through muscle in shield arm. If foe has a shield, he drops it.

D.text: Strike to foe's shield arm. Arm is useless.

E.text: Strike foe in weapon arm, the bone is broken. Arm is useless.

A.text: Deep wound in foe's side. Well, it looked like a killing blow.

B.text: Tear open foe's side in a graphic display of violence.

C.text: Strike bites into foe's ribs. The impact sounds truly terrible.

D.text: Major abdominal wound. Blood pours out in frightening quantities.

E.text: Strike to foe's back severs a vein. Foe goes to his knees and dies in 12 rounds.

A.text: Catch foe in the back. He drops his guard and stumbles forward.

B.text: Strike to foe's head. If foe has no helm he dies. If foe has helm, he falls to his knees.

C.text: Strike impacts on foe's head. If he has no helm, he dies. Helm is destroyed.

D.text: Strike through foe's kidneys. Foe is down and immobile for 2 hours, then he dies.

E.text: Strike plunges in just below foe's collarbone. Foe drops and dies in 12 rounds.

A.text: Strike to foe's ear. Foe hears at -50.

C.text: Strike to chest. If foe has plate chest armor, he drops and dies in 9 rounds. If not, he dies instantly.

D.text: Strike through foe's side spills his guts on the floor. Foe fights on normally for 6 rounds, then dies.

E.text: Your weapon passes through the arm and sticks out the other side. Foe dies in 12 rounds.

A.text: Strike to nose. There is a permanent scar. Foe's eyes are crossed for a moment.

B.text: Strike through foe's cheek and throat. Foe drops and dies after 9 rounds of incapacity.

C.text: Strike through foe's neck breaks backbone and severs spine. Foe is paralyzed from the neck down.

D.text: Strike plunges into doomed foe's chest and emerges from the other side. Foe drops and dies in 6 rounds.

E.text: Shot through heart sends foe reeling back 10 feet to a place suitable for death. Your weapon is stuck in reeling foe.

A.text: Strike through neck. Sever vein and artery. Foe cannot breathe. Foe drops and dies of heart failure.

B.text: Strike plunges into foe's eye. Foe dies instantly. Foe remains standing for a moment until he realizes this.

C.text: Shot through both ears proves effective. Foe dies instantly. Pretty shot.

D.text: Strike through brain makes life difficult for foe. You have a half round left to act.

E.text: Strike to foe's eye. Foe dies instantly. Carry on soldier.
